name: Magatha Grimtotem
summary: On Elder Rise, Magatha Grimtotem challenges Cairne Bloodhoof's vision for the tauren. The Grimtotem matriarch and Thunder Bluff's Elder Crone is a formidable shaman and political schemer.

sections.title: The Matriarch of Elder Rise
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem leads the Grimtotem tribe from Elder Rise, with her own retinue and bodyguards. She gained authority through an arranged union, then her mate died suddenly in a climbing accident. Her reclusive tribe follows her as its political and spiritual leader. Magatha preaches tauren dominance, unlike Cairne Bloodhoof. She sees other mortal races as intruders on Kalimdor, to be eradicated or swept aside.

sections.title: A Curious Alliance
sections.body: Though Magatha openly disdains other races, she was among the first to advocate admitting the Forsaken to the Horde. She says the tauren can teach the undead spiritual balance and help them reclaim their humanity. Magatha also works directly with the Royal Apothecary Society beneath Thunder Bluff, consulting figures such as Apothecary Zamah about practical alchemy and arcane relics.

sections.title: Political Machinations
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem counsels Cairne while working to weaken his authority and testing the defenses of potential threats. She sends adventurers into dangerous places, from Ragefire Chasm to face trogg forces to a hunt for the vengeful spirit Arikara. Each assignment builds Grimtotem influence or prepares her to supplant the Bloodhoof dynasty.

faq.answer: Magatha Grimtotem is the Elder Crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem tribe. A gifted shaman since childhood, she took total rule after her mate died in a climbing accident. She resides on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and is Cairne Bloodhoof's chief political rival.

faq.q: Why does Magatha support the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Magatha says tauren traditions and shamanic wisdom can guide the Forsaken back toward humanity. Many suspect her ties to the Royal Apothecary Society seek alchemical secrets and allies beyond Cairne's loyal inner circle.

faq.q: What is Magatha's relationship with Cairne Bloodhoof?
faq.answer: Magatha sees Cairne Bloodhoof as soft, naive, and unfit to lead the united tauren. Cairne favors coexistence in the Horde and peace across Kalimdor; Magatha believes the Grimtotem should reclaim ancestral lands by force and eliminate foreign intruders.

faq.q: What was the mission in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Magatha sent Maur into Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar to negotiate with its troggs. They killed him, so she sent Horde adventurers into the cavern to retrieve his satchel and butcher the troggs in retribution.

Arikara is a vengeful wind serpent spirit said to seek retribution against the tauren. Magatha says Arikara seeks vengeance against Cairne Bloodhoof and sends capable champions to summon and slay the beast with enchanted agave.

faq.q: Where can Magatha Grimtotem be found?
faq.answer: Magatha resides in the large main tent atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, attended by her servant Rahauro and two stoic Grimtotem guards.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the Grimtotem's dark reputation. Magatha's presence on Elder Rise reminds you of the ideological divide threatening the united tribes.
As Forsaken, you find a surprisingly warm welcome from the Elder Crone, who consults the Royal Apothecary Society in the Pools of Vision.
As a shaman, you face one of Kalimdor's most powerful practitioners, whose command of the primal elements few living tauren can rival.
As a member of the Horde, you may find Magatha's aid and counsel valuable against regional threats. Her fierce clan loyalty and open contempt for other races make her an untrustworthy comrade.
